items.text: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.
Ten minutes of walking after a meal is an easy win.
Keep a steady sleep schedule, even on weekends.
Stand up and stretch for one minute every hour.
Put your phone away 30 minutes before bed.
Add one vegetable to every meal.
Take five slow breaths when you feel stressed.
Get some daylight in the first hour after waking up.
Eat slowly. Put the fork down between bites.
Small daily movement beats rare hard workouts.
Be kind to yourself. Progress is not a straight line.
